class SecurityPolicyValidator:
    """Fail-closed security policy validation before and after dispatch."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._pending: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()

    @staticmethod
    def _deny(code: str, route: str, detail: str) -> None:
        raise SecurityPolicyError(code, route, detail)

    def validate_pre_dispatch(
        self,
        envelope: SecurityEnvelope | None,
        request: SecurityRequest | None,
        *,
        now: datetime | None = None,
    ) -> SecurityDecision:
        if envelope is None or request is None:
            self._deny("SECURITY_BINDING_MISSING", "SECURITY_OWNER", "security envelope and request are required")
        assert envelope is not None and request is not None
        instant = (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).astimezone(timezone.utc)
        if _utc(envelope.issued_at, "security.issued_at") > instant or _utc(
            envelope.expires_at, "security.expires_at"
        ) <= instant:
            self._deny("SECURITY_POLICY_STALE", "SECURITY_OWNER", "security policy is not current")
        if contains_secret_value(envelope) or contains_secret_value(request):
            self._deny("SECRET_VALUE_FORBIDDEN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "secret-shaped values are not governance payloads")

        handling = envelope.data_handling
        for label, reference in (
            ("classification", handling.classification_reference),
            ("handling policy", handling.policy_reference),
            ("redaction", handling.redaction_reference),
            ("retention", handling.retention_reference),
            ("encryption", handling.encryption_reference),
            ("audit", envelope.audit_reference),
        ):
            _reference(reference, label)
        if request.data_class is DataClass.PROHIBITED or handling.data_class is DataClass.PROHIBITED:
            self._deny("DATA_CLASS_PROHIBITED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "prohibited data cannot be dispatched")
        if request.data_class is not handling.data_class:
            self._deny("DATA_CLASS_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "classification does not match its handling policy")
        if request.transmit_data and not handling.transmission_allowed:
            self._deny("DATA_TRANSMISSION_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "handling policy forbids transmission")
        if request.environment not in handling.allowed_environments:
            self._deny("DATA_ENVIRONMENT_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "handling policy does not allow this environment")

        if (request.project_id, request.environment, request.session_id) != (
            envelope.project_id, envelope.environment, envelope.session_id,
        ):
            self._deny("SECURITY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "project/environment/session binding changed")
        if request.provider_session_id != envelope.provider_session_id:
            self._deny("PROVIDER_SESSION_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "provider session is not bound to this dispatch")
        if request.sandbox_class is not envelope.sandbox_class:
            self._deny("SANDBOX_CLASS_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "requested sandbox differs from policy")
        if request.untrusted_instruction_findings:
            self._deny(
                "SUSPECTED_PROMPT_INJECTION", "SECURITY_REVIEW",
                "untrusted instruction finding requires review before any side effect",
            )
        if request.malicious_tool_findings:
            self._deny(
                "MALICIOUS_TOOL_ESCALATION", "SECURITY_REVIEW",
                "tool escalation or confused-deputy finding requires review",
            )

        environment = request.environment.casefold()
        if request.sandbox_class is SandboxClass.S0_READ_ONLY_REASONING:
            if any(item.access is FilesystemAccess.WRITE for item in request.filesystem) or request.production_action:
                self._deny("SANDBOX_POLICY_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "S0 is read-only")
        elif request.sandbox_class is SandboxClass.S1_WORKSPACE_WRITE:
            if environment in {"production", "prod"} or request.production_action:
                self._deny("PRODUCTION_BOUNDARY_DENIED", "HUMAN_DECISION", "general Stage08 sandbox cannot act on production")
        elif request.sandbox_class is SandboxClass.S2_STAGING_OPERATION:
            if environment != "staging" or request.production_action:
                self._deny("SANDBOX_POLICY_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "S2 is restricted to staging")
        elif request.sandbox_class is SandboxClass.S3_PROTECTED_PRODUCTION_ACTION:
            if environment not in {"production", "prod"} or not request.production_action:
                self._deny("PRODUCTION_BOUNDARY_DENIED", "HUMAN_DECISION", "S3 requires an exact production action")
            if request.approval_class not in {"A2", "A3"} or not envelope.production_action_granted:
                self._deny("PRODUCTION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED", "HUMAN_DECISION", "S3 requires exact A2/A3 authority")

        if len(set(request.filesystem)) != len(request.filesystem) or set(request.filesystem) != set(
            envelope.filesystem_grants
        ):
            self._deny("FILESYSTEM_PATH_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "filesystem request is absent, duplicate, or unlisted")
        if len(set(request.network)) != len(request.network) or set(request.network) != set(envelope.network_grants):
            self._deny("NETWORK_POLICY_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "network destination/purpose/access is unlisted")
        if len(set(request.credentials)) != len(request.credentials) or set(request.credentials) != set(
            envelope.credential_grants
        ):
            self._deny("CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "credential class/reference is unlisted")
        if len(set(request.secret_references)) != len(request.secret_references) or set(
            request.secret_references
        ) != set(envelope.secret_reference_grants):
            self._deny("SECRET_ACCESS_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "secret reference is unlisted")
        if len(set(request.processes)) != len(request.processes) or set(request.processes) != set(
            envelope.process_grants
        ):
            self._deny("PROCESS_EXECUTION_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "process is unlisted")

        for grant in request.network:
            _reference(grant.purpose, "network purpose")
            if not grant.destination or "*" in grant.destination or any(char.isspace() for char in grant.destination):
                self._deny("NETWORK_POLICY_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "network destination must be exact")
            if grant.access is NetworkAccess.PROTECTED_PRODUCTION_ENDPOINT and request.sandbox_class is not SandboxClass.S3_PROTECTED_PRODUCTION_ACTION:
                self._deny("PRODUCTION_BOUNDARY_DENIED", "HUMAN_DECISION", "production endpoint requires S3")
        for grant in request.credentials:
            for label, value in (("credential class", grant.credential_class), ("credential reference", grant.reference), ("credential purpose", grant.purpose)):
                _reference(value, label)
            if (grant.project_id, grant.environment, grant.session_id) != (
                request.project_id, request.environment, request.session_id,
            ):
                self._deny("CREDENTIAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH", "SECURITY_OWNER", "credential crosses project/environment/session")
            if _utc(grant.expires_at, "credential.expires_at") <= instant:
                self._deny("CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE", "SECURITY_OWNER", "credential reference is expired")
            if _PRODUCTION_CREDENTIAL.search(grant.credential_class) and request.sandbox_class is not SandboxClass.S3_PROTECTED_PRODUCTION_ACTION:
                self._deny("PRODUCTION_CREDENTIAL_DENIED", "HUMAN_DECISION", "production credential cannot enter a general sandbox")
        for grant in request.secret_references:
            _reference(grant.reference, "secret reference")
            _reference(grant.purpose, "secret purpose")
            if (grant.project_id, grant.environment, grant.session_id) != (
                request.project_id, request.environment, request.session_id,
            ):
                self._deny("SECRET_ACCESS_DENIED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "secret reference crosses project/environment/session")
        for process in request.processes:
            _reference(process, "process")

        key = (request.project_id, request.session_id, envelope.audit_reference)
        if key in self._pending:
            self._deny("SECURITY_DISPATCH_REUSED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "security policy is already pending")
        self._pending.add(key)
        return SecurityDecision("PASS", _safe_categories(envelope, request))

    def reconcile_post_dispatch(
        self,
        envelope: SecurityEnvelope,
        request: SecurityRequest,
        observation: SecurityObservation | None,
    ) -> SecurityDecision:
        key = (request.project_id, request.session_id, envelope.audit_reference)
        if key not in self._pending:
            self._deny("SECURITY_DISPATCH_NOT_AUTHORIZED", "SECURITY_OWNER", "no successful security preflight exists")
        self._pending.remove(key)
        if observation is None:
            self._deny("SECURITY_OBSERVATION_MISSING", "SECURITY_OWNER", "post-dispatch boundary evidence is required")
        if observation.suspected_secret_exposure:
            self._deny(
                "SUSPECTED_SECRET_EXPOSURE", "SECURITY_INCIDENT_RESPONSE",
                "affected flow stopped; preserve redacted evidence and revoke/rotate as applicable",
            )
        if contains_secret_value(observation):
            self._deny("SECRET_VALUE_FORBIDDEN", "SECURITY_INCIDENT_RESPONSE", "post-dispatch evidence contains a secret-shaped value")
        if not set(observation.filesystem).issubset(set(request.filesystem)):
            self._deny("ACTUAL_FILESYSTEM_OVERRUN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "actual filesystem access exceeded its grant")
        if not set(observation.network).issubset(set(request.network)):
            self._deny("ACTUAL_NETWORK_OVERRUN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "actual network access exceeded its grant")
        allowed_credentials = {item.reference for item in request.credentials}
        if not set(observation.credential_references).issubset(allowed_credentials):
            self._deny("ACTUAL_CREDENTIAL_OVERRUN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "actual credential access exceeded its grant")
        allowed_secrets = {item.reference for item in request.secret_references}
        if not set(observation.secret_references).issubset(allowed_secrets):
            self._deny("ACTUAL_SECRET_OVERRUN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "actual secret access exceeded its grant")
        if not set(observation.processes).issubset(set(request.processes)):
            self._deny("ACTUAL_PROCESS_OVERRUN", "SECURITY_OWNER", "actual process exceeded its grant")
        if observation.production_action and not request.production_action:
            self._deny("ACTUAL_PRODUCTION_OVERRUN", "HUMAN_DECISION", "unapproved production action observed")
        if not observation.evidence_reference:
            self._deny("SAFE_AUDIT_PATH_MISSING", "EVIDENCE_OWNER", "security reconciliation needs a safe evidence reference")
        _reference(observation.evidence_reference, "security evidence")
        audit = dict(_safe_categories(envelope, request))
        audit.update(
            {
                "outcome": "RECONCILED",
                "actual_filesystem_paths": tuple(item.path for item in observation.filesystem),
                "actual_network_destinations": tuple(item.destination for item in observation.network),
                "actual_credential_references": observation.credential_references,
                "actual_secret_references": observation.secret_references,
                "actual_processes": observation.processes,
                "evidence_reference": observation.evidence_reference,
            }
        )
        return SecurityDecision("PASS", MappingProxyType(audit))


def create_security_envelope(
    *,
    request: SecurityRequest,
    classification_reference: str,
    policy_reference: str,
    redaction_reference: str,
    retention_reference: str,
    encryption_reference: str,
    audit_reference: str,
    allowed_environments: Iterable[str] | None = None,
    lifetime_seconds: int = 300,
    now: datetime | None = None,
) -> SecurityEnvelope:
    """Bind caller-declared policy references and exact grants without widening them."""

    instant = (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).astimezone(timezone.utc)
    expires = instant + timedelta(seconds=max(1, lifetime_seconds))
    return SecurityEnvelope(
        data_handling=DataHandlingBinding(
            data_class=request.data_class,
            classification_reference=classification_reference,
            policy_reference=policy_reference,
            redaction_reference=redaction_reference,
            retention_reference=retention_reference,
            encryption_reference=encryption_reference,
            allowed_environments=tuple(allowed_environments or (request.environment,)),
            transmission_allowed=request.transmit_data,
        ),
        sandbox_class=request.sandbox_class,
        project_id=request.project_id,
        environment=request.environment,
        session_id=request.session_id,
        provider_session_id=request.provider_session_id,
        filesystem_grants=request.filesystem,
        network_grants=request.network,
        credential_grants=request.credentials,
        secret_reference_grants=request.secret_references,
        process_grants=request.processes,
        production_action_granted=request.production_action,
        audit_reference=audit_reference,
        issued_at=instant.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
        expires_at=expires.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    )

246-## 10. Failure, recovery, and safety design
247-
248-### DES-012 - Durable failure envelope and recovery router
249-
250:- **Decision:** Represent every AI/provider, command, Git, test, lifecycle, authority, security, or execution failure in a common failure envelope: stable identity, operation/step, affected scope, cause class, persisted pre-operation identity, valid completed work, partial outputs, truthful status, unsafe-continuation flag, and eligible routes.
251-- **Upstream SPEC:** `SPEC-009`.
252-- **Rationale:** One minimal envelope gives all failure classes consistent preservation and reporting without pretending their remedies are identical.
253-- **Responsibilities/boundary:** The failing adapter supplies facts; the orchestrator persists the envelope; authority resolver/lifecycle governor determine eligibility; the recovery router offers only precondition-valid retry, alternate, remediation, revision, escalation, or Human Decision routes.
254-- **Data/state interaction:** Retry creates a linked attempt and never erases the original. Partial work is retained and classified; only independently valid completed work remains complete.
--
257-- **Downstream constraints for Stage05/06/08:** Governance defines permitted recovery operations; tasks expose resumable boundaries; Stage08 reports partial progress without unauthorized cleanup or continuation.
258-
259-### DES-017 - Append-only post-checkpoint implementation-evidence recovery
260-
261:- **Decision:** Add a distinct, explicitly authorized recovery-attestation path alongside, not inside or in place of, ordinary atomic Stage08 evidence creation. A recovery attestation is a versioned repository record with these required conceptual fields: `record_kind=POST_CHECKPOINT_IMPLEMENTATION_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY`; evidence schema/version; stable recovery-attempt identity and deterministic sequence relation to earlier attempts; task identity; historical implementation checkpoint commit identity and its Git tree identity; task-attributable checkpoint changed paths and content/diff digest; applicable authority-baseline identities and task-contract digest; exact authoritative verification-command text and command digest; truthful verification outcome, exit status, complete-result indicator, bounded stdout/stderr references or captures, start/end time, and timeout state; recovery-authorization identity, scope digest, status, and validity interval or single-use state as later governed; execution adapter/tool identity and version plus interpreter, host-or-sandbox mode, working-directory/repository identity, and material environment facts; pre- and post-verification HEAD, tracked implementation-tree identity, and worktree observations proving no implementation mutation; record creation time; links to prior attempt and ordinary evidence, when present; and a canonical record-content digest. Field representation and canonical serialization are selected here as a versioned JSON object because the current evidence registry already persists Stage08 evidence as JSON; schema evolution must reject unsupported required semantics and must not reinterpret older ordinary records.
262-- **Upstream SPEC:** `SPEC-017`, preserving `SPEC-007`, `SPEC-008`, `SPEC-009`, and `SPEC-016`.
263-- **Rationale:** An independently typed, content-bound attestation can establish new proof about an unchanged historical checkpoint without amending Git history or pretending the proof existed at checkpoint time. Reusing the ordinary record shape or ordinary checkpoint validator would make arbitrary later evidence indistinguishable from authorized recovery.
264-- **Ordinary/recovery discriminator:** Ordinary evidence retains its existing record kind or legacy ordinary interpretation, atomic checkpoint membership, sealed-envelope bindings, and qualification rules unchanged. Only the exact recovery discriminator enters this recovery pipeline. Missing, unknown, or contradictory discriminator/schema information is non-qualifying; the ordinary writer and validator never infer recovery, and the recovery validator never upgrades an ordinary record that failed ordinary atomicity.
265-- **Checkpoint linkage and integrity:** Resolve the attestation's full checkpoint commit identity without symbolic-name substitution; require the commit to exist and be an ancestor of the governed current history; compare its recorded Git tree identity with Git; reconstruct the checkpoint's task-attributable diff against its governed parent; require every changed implementation path to be within the bound task scope; and compare the ordered path/content or diff digest with the attestation and bound task contract. Later commits do not invalidate recovery merely because they follow the checkpoint, but cannot change the historical objects, supply missing checkpoint content, or be included in the verified implementation snapshot. Verification executes against an isolated exact view of the historical checkpoint while persistence occurs only on the current governed branch after confirming that branch and history remained unchanged. Merge ambiguity, missing parent identity, rewritten ancestry, content mismatch, or inability to isolate the checkpoint blocks recovery. No recovery operation amends, rebases, replaces, or otherwise mutates the historical commit.
--
300-- **Failure behavior:** Ambiguous migration, malformed history, evidence/state or checkpoint mismatch, incompatible duplicate, stale projection without fully provable correction, atomic-write uncertainty, partial migration, unsupported schema, or lost prior record blocks the entire affected transaction and preserves the last valid state. Failures identify the task, checkpoint/evidence identities, stable reason, and safe remediation route. No fallback to singleton ordering, partial write, silent downgrade, cursor advance, or inferred authority is permitted.
301-- **Verification implication:** Stage06 must require schema `1.0` to `2.0` migration for empty, valid, cursor-bearing, incomplete, unproved, and conflicting legacy states; exact current T019 migration; additive T012 reconciliation with both records preserved and T019 projections unchanged; ordinary sequential and out-of-order recovered qualification; zero/one/many records; deterministic serialization and duplicate-key rejection; compatibility projection derivation and ambiguity; task-specific dependency lookup for T012/T019 plus false missing dependency and blocking malformed/non-PASS records; idempotent duplicate reconciliation; compatible additional and conflicting evidence; conflicting checkpoint; atomic temp/write/replace/reload failures; retry after interruption and caller timeout; fresh-runner reconstruction; monotonicity; no automatic next-task selection; ordinary Stage08 regression; recovery qualification separation; and rejection of Stage07, Stage09, Stage10/release, or deployment upgrade.
302-- **Downstream constraints:** Stage05 must review whether schema migration/state reconciliation needs additional protected-operation governance; Stage06 must create a separate atomic implementation task with exact files and verification. This decision creates neither task nor execution authority and does not perform T012 reconciliation.
303-
304:### DES-013 - Safety interlock and minimum-disclosure reporting
305-
306:- **Decision:** Place a safety interlock before destructive/high-risk operations and before resuming security- or authority-blocked scope. It validates exact target/scope, required explicit authorization, current authority identity, and absence of unresolved blockers. Reports minimize sensitive values while retaining actionable category, scope, owner, and safe reference.
307-- **Upstream SPEC:** `SPEC-010`, `SPEC-004`.
308-- **Rationale:** Centralized preflight prevents automatic bypass and avoids leaking secrets in otherwise useful reports.
309-- **Responsibilities/boundary:** Adapters identify proposed operation; the interlock requests authorization/owner resolution; Human Decision handles required explicit consent; authority owner resolves conflicts. No component may self-clear its own blocker.
310-- **Data/state interaction:** Persist confirmation identity and bounded target, not unnecessary sensitive content. Security blockers propagate to all proven-dependent work; unaffected isolation requires an explicit dependency finding.
311:- **Failure behavior:** Ambiguous target, missing confirmation, unauthorized scope, security concern, or authority conflict yields `BLOCKED`. Conflicts follow the required four-step protocol; automatic continuation remains forbidden.
312:- **Verification implication:** Exercise destructive, high-risk, security, and conflict cases; bypass attempts; sensitive-data redaction; authorized safe continuation; and unaffected-scope isolation.
313-- **Downstream constraints for Stage05/06/08:** Stage05 must define concrete protected operations and confirmation policy; Stage06 must expose risk/scope; Stage08 must call the interlock and cannot suppress its result.

 138: class ReasoningProviderBoundary:
 139:     """Provider-independent guard for SPEC-006 / SPEC-009 / DES-006.
 140: 
 141:     This port does not persist output or grant authority. It validates the
 142:     provider exchange and returns proposed output for an owning boundary to
 143:     validate further and, when authorized, persist.
 144:     """
 145: 
 146:     def __init__(
 147:         self,
 148:         provider: ReasoningProvider,
 149:         *,
 150:         authorization_validator: Callable[[SealedExecutionEnvelope], bool] | None = None,
 151:         governance_validator: GovernanceEnvelopeValidator | None = None,
 152:         require_governance: bool = False,
 153:     ):
 154:         self.provider = provider
 155:         self.authorization_validator = authorization_validator
 156:         self.governance_validator = governance_validator or GovernanceEnvelopeValidator()
 157:         self.require_governance = require_governance
 158: 
 159:     @staticmethod
 160:     def _safe_detail(detail: str) -> str:
 161:         bounded = detail[:1000]
 162:         legacy_redacted = re.sub(
 163:             r"(?i)(authorization\s*[:=]\s*bearer|api[_-]?key\s*[:=])\s*[^\s,;]+",
 164:             r"\1 [REDACTED]",
 165:             bounded,
 166:         )
 167:         return str(redact_security_value(legacy_redacted))
 168: 
 169:     @staticmethod
 170:     def _failure(invocation: ReasoningInvocation, category: str, detail: str) -> ReasoningBoundaryResult:
 171:         return ReasoningBoundaryResult(
 172:             status="BLOCKED",
 173:             attempt_id=invocation.attempt_id,
 174:             operation=invocation.operation,
 175:             failure=ProviderFailure(
 176:                 category=category,
 177:                 attempt_id=invocation.attempt_id,
 178:                 operation=invocation.operation,
 179:                 affected_scope=invocation.affected_scope,
 180:                 detail=ReasoningProviderBoundary._safe_detail(detail),
 181:                 eligible_routes=_FAILURE_ROUTES[category],
 182:             ),
 183:         )
 184: 
 185:     def _envelope_covers(self, invocation: ReasoningInvocation) -> bool:
 186:         envelope = invocation.authorization_envelope
 187:         if envelope is None or invocation.request.stage_id != "08":
 188:             return False
 189:         if not envelope.envelope_id or not envelope.task_id or not envelope.baseline_commit:
 190:             return False
 191:         allowed = set(envelope.allowed_paths)
 192:         if not allowed or not all(path in allowed for path in invocation.affected_scope):
 193:             return False
 194:         if self.authorization_validator is None:
 195:             return False
 196:         try:
 197:             return self.authorization_validator(envelope) is True
 198:         except Exception:
 199:             return False
 200: 
 201:     def _preflight(self, invocation: ReasoningInvocation) -> ReasoningBoundaryResult | None:
 202:         if not invocation.attempt_id.strip() or not invocation.operation.strip():
 203:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "attempt_id and operation are required")
 204:         if not invocation.authoritative_context_refs:
 205:             return self._failure(
 206:                 invocation,
 207:                 "AUTHORITY_CROSSING",
 208:                 "authoritative context references are required; chat context is not authority",
 209:             )
 210:         if not invocation.affected_scope:
 211:             return self._failure(invocation, "OUT_OF_SCOPE", "affected scope must be declared")
 212:         unknown = invocation.permitted_capabilities - REASONING_CAPABILITIES
 213:         if unknown or not invocation.permitted_capabilities:
 214:             return self._failure(
 215:                 invocation,
 216:                 "POLICY_VIOLATION",
 217:                 f"undeclared or unsupported capabilities: {sorted(unknown)}",
 218:             )
 219:         if invocation.expected_result != "STAGE_EXECUTION_RESULT":
 220:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "unsupported expected structured result")
 221:         if WRITE_CAPABILITY in invocation.permitted_capabilities and not self._envelope_covers(invocation):
 222:             return self._failure(
 223:                 invocation,
 224:                 "NO_AUTHORIZATION",
 225:                 "write-capable invocation requires a sealed Stage08 envelope covering affected scope",
 226:             )
 227:         governance_fields = (
 228:             invocation.governance_envelope,
 229:             invocation.governance_request,
 230:             invocation.current_identity,
 231:         )
 232:         if self.require_governance or any(item is not None for item in governance_fields):
 233:             if any(item is None for item in governance_fields):
 234:                 return self._failure(
 235:                     invocation, "NO_AUTHORIZATION",
 236:                     "complete unified governance envelope bindings are required",
 237:                 )

 240:                     invocation.governance_envelope,
 241:                     invocation.governance_request,
 242:                     current_identity=invocation.current_identity,
 243:                 )
 244:             except GovernanceEnvelopeError as exc:
 245:                 category = (
 246:                     "AUTHORITY_CROSSING"
 247:                     if exc.code in {"PROVIDER_AUTHORITY_CLAIM", "APPROVAL_MISMATCH"}
 248:                     else "POLICY_VIOLATION"
 249:                 )
 250:                 return self._failure(invocation, category, f"{exc.code}: {exc.detail}")
 251:         return None

 253:     def _validate_output(
 254:         self, invocation: ReasoningInvocation, output: Any
 255:     ) -> ReasoningBoundaryResult | None:
 256:         if not isinstance(output, StageExecutionResult):
 257:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned no StageExecutionResult")
 258:         if output.status not in {"COMPLETED", "BLOCKED"}:
 259:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned an invalid status")
 260:         if not isinstance(output.artifacts, dict) or any(
 261:             not isinstance(path, str) or not isinstance(content, str)
 262:             for path, content in output.artifacts.items()
 263:         ):
 264:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned invalid artifacts")
 265:         if not isinstance(output.metadata, dict):
 266:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned invalid metadata")
 267:         if not isinstance(output.remediation_reasons, list) or any(
 268:             not isinstance(reason, str) for reason in output.remediation_reasons
 269:         ):
 270:             return self._failure(
 271:                 invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned invalid remediation reasons"
 272:             )
 273:         result_vocabulary = set(
 274:             invocation.request.contract.get("result_vocabulary", []) or []
 275:         )
 276:         if output.result is not None and result_vocabulary and output.result not in result_vocabulary:
 277:             return self._failure(
 278:                 invocation, "MALFORMED", "provider returned a result outside the stage vocabulary"
 279:             )
 280:         allowed_outputs = set(_allowed_output_paths(invocation.request))
 281:         unexpected = set(output.artifacts) - allowed_outputs
 282:         if unexpected:
 283:             return self._failure(
 284:                 invocation,
 285:                 "OUT_OF_SCOPE",
 286:                 f"provider emitted artifacts outside declared outputs: {sorted(unexpected)}",
 287:             )
 288:         forbidden_claims = {

 290:             "approval_created",
 291:             "evidence_created",

 294:         }
 295:         claims = {key for key in forbidden_claims if output.metadata.get(key)}
 296:         if claims:

 298:                 invocation,
 299:                 "AUTHORITY_CROSSING",
 300:                 f"provider attempted governed-core claims: {sorted(claims)}",
 301:             )
 302:         return None

 304:     def invoke(self, invocation: ReasoningInvocation) -> ReasoningBoundaryResult:
 305:         blocked = self._preflight(invocation)
 306:         if blocked is not None:
 307:             return blocked
 308:         try:
 309:             output = self.provider.execute(invocation.request)
 310:         except (TimeoutError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
 311:             return self._failure(invocation, "TIMEOUT", str(exc) or "provider timed out")
 312:         except (ProviderUnavailableError, SharedReasoningProviderPrerequisiteError) as exc:
 313:             return self._failure(invocation, "UNAVAILABLE", str(exc))
 314:         except ProviderPolicyViolationError as exc:

 316:         except Exception as exc:
 317:             return self._failure(invocation, "MALFORMED", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")

 319:         try:
 320:             blocked = self._validate_output(invocation, output)
 321:         except Exception as exc:
 322:             return self._failure(
 323:                 invocation, "MALFORMED", f"output validation failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
 324:             )
 325:         if blocked is not None:
 326:             return blocked
 327:         if invocation.governance_envelope is not None:
 328:             assert invocation.governance_request is not None

 330:                 self.governance_validator.reconcile_post_dispatch(
 331:                     invocation.governance_envelope,

 333:                     DispatchObservation(

 375: def _allowed_output_paths(request: StageExecutionRequest) -> list[str]:
 376:     paths = list(request.contract.get("outputs", {}).get("files", []) or [])
 377:     # Optional output globs cannot be represented safely as arbitrary paths in a
 378:     # strict JSON schema. They remain available through the external-command
 379:     # executor and can be added to provider-specific adapters later.
 380:     return paths
 381: 
 382: 
 383: def _result_schema(request: StageExecutionRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
 384:     paths = _allowed_output_paths(request)
 385:     result_vocab = request.contract.get("result_vocabulary", []) or []
 386: 
 387:     result_schema: dict[str, Any]
 388:     if result_vocab:
 389:         result_schema = {"type": ["string", "null"], "enum": [*result_vocab, None]}
 390:     else:
 391:         result_schema = {"type": ["string", "null"]}
 392: 
 393:     # Only Stage 09 owns implementation-gap / authority-conflict classification.
 394:     # Other stages must keep classification null and describe blockers through
 395:     # the stage report + remediation_reasons. This prevents Stage 07 readiness
 396:     # failures from being mislabeled as Stage 09 IMPLEMENTATION_GAP.
 397:     classification_values = (
 398:         ["IMPLEMENTATION_GAP", "AUTHORITY_CONTRACT_CONFLICT", None]
 399:         if request.stage_id == "09"
 400:         else [None]
 401:     )
 402: 
 403:     schema = {
 404:         "type": "object",
 405:         "properties": {
 406:             "status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["COMPLETED", "BLOCKED"]},
 407:             "artifacts": {
 408:                 "type": "array",
 409:                 "items": {
 410:                     "type": "object",
 411:                     "properties": {
 412:                         "path": {"type": "string", "enum": paths or ["__NO_OUTPUT__"]},
 413:                         "content": {"type": "string"},
 414:                     },
 415:                     "required": ["path", "content"],
 416:                     "additionalProperties": False,
 417:                 },
 418:             },
 419:             "result": result_schema,
 420:             "classification": {
 421:                 "type": ["string", "null"],
 422:                 "enum": classification_values,
 423:             },
 424:             "remediation_reasons": {
 425:                 "type": "array",
 426:                 "items": {"type": "string"},
 427:             },
 428:             "provider_notes": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
 429:         },
 430:         "required": [
 431:             "status",
 432:             "artifacts",
 433:             "result",
 434:             "classification",
 435:             "remediation_reasons",
 436:             "provider_notes",
 437:         ],
 438:         "additionalProperties": False,
 439:     }
 440: 
 441:     if request.stage_id == "09":
 442:         schema["properties"]["convergence_tasks"] = {
 443:             "type": "array",
 444:             "items": {
 445:                 "type": "object",
 446:                 "properties": {
 447:                     "task_id": {"type": "string"},
 448:                     "title": {"type": "string"},
 449:                     "objective": {"type": "string"},
 450:                     "traceability": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
 451:                     "allowed_paths": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
 452:                     "verification_commands": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
 453:                 },
 454:                 "required": [
 455:                     "task_id",
 456:                     "title",
 457:                     "objective",
 458:                     "traceability",
 459:                     "allowed_paths",
 460:                     "verification_commands",
 461:                 ],
 462:                 "additionalProperties": False,
 463:             },
 464:         }
 465:         schema["required"].append("convergence_tasks")
 466: 
 467:     return schema
 468:

 470: def _provider_system_instructions(request: StageExecutionRequest) -> str:
 471:     base = """You are a governed SDD stage executor inside a repository-first software development system.
 472: 
 473: You MUST follow the stage contract and authority boundaries supplied in the request. Never use linear document priority such as PRD > Spec > Design. Resolve authority by domain. If authoritative artifacts conflict, do not choose a winner or invent a workaround: report BLOCKED and provide remediation reasons. Do not claim to have run repository commands unless runtime evidence is present in the request.
 474: 
 475: Return only the structured result required by the response schema. Artifact content must be complete file content, not commentary around the file. Do not emit files outside the declared output paths.
 476: """
 477:     if request.stage_instructions:
 478:         base += "\nSTAGE-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:\n" + request.stage_instructions
 479:     else:
 480:         base += (
 481:             "\nNo separate stage instruction file is installed. Treat the machine-readable "
 482:             "stage contract in the request as binding and do not expand authority beyond it."
 483:         )
 484:     return base
 485: 
 486: 
 487: def _provider_user_input(request: StageExecutionRequest) -> str:
 488:     payload = request.to_dict()
 489:     return (
 490:         "Execute this SDD stage using only the supplied authoritative context. "
 491:         "Preserve traceability and mark unresolved critical uncertainty as blocked/TBD rather than guessing.\n\n"
 492:         + json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
 493:     )
 494: 
 495: 
 496: def _extract_output_text(response: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
 497:     direct = response.get("output_text")
 498:     if isinstance(direct, str) and direct.strip():
 499:         return direct
 500: 
 501:     for item in response.get("output", []) or []:
 502:         if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") != "message":
 503:             continue
 504:         for content in item.get("content", []) or []:
 505:             if not isinstance(content, dict):
 506:                 continue
 507:             if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
 508:                 text = content.get("text")
 509:                 if isinstance(text, str) and text.strip():
 510:                     return text
 511:     raise ReasoningProviderError("OpenAI response did not contain output text")
 512: 
 513: 
 514: def _non_negative_int(value: Any) -> int | None:
 515:     return (
 516:         value
 517:         if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool) and value >= 0
 518:         else None
 519:     )
 520: 
 521: 
 522: def _openai_response_usage(payload: Any) -> Usage | None:
 523:     if not isinstance(payload, dict):
 524:         return None
 525:     raw_usage = payload.get("usage")
 526:     if not isinstance(raw_usage, dict):
 527:         return None
 528: 
 529:     input_tokens = _non_negative_int(raw_usage.get("input_tokens"))
 530:     output_tokens = _non_negative_int(raw_usage.get("output_tokens"))
 531:     total_tokens = _non_negative_int(raw_usage.get("total_tokens"))
 532:     if input_tokens is None and output_tokens is None and total_tokens is None:
 533:         return None
 534: 
 535:     input_details = raw_usage.get("input_tokens_details")
 536:     output_details = raw_usage.get("output_tokens_details")
 537:     cached_input_tokens = (
 538:         _non_negative_int(input_details.get("cached_tokens"))
 539:         if isinstance(input_details, dict)
 540:         else None
 541:     )
 542:     reasoning_output_tokens = (
 543:         _non_negative_int(output_details.get("reasoning_tokens"))
 544:         if isinstance(output_details, dict)
 545:         else None
 546:     )
 547:     return Usage(
 548:         availability=Availability.AVAILABLE,
 549:         quality=Quality.ACTUAL,
 550:         usage_source=UsageSource.OPENAI_RESPONSES_USAGE,
 551:         input_tokens=input_tokens,
 552:         output_tokens=output_tokens,
 553:         total_tokens=total_tokens,
 554:         component_tokens={
 555:             "cached_input_tokens": cached_input_tokens,
 556:             "reasoning_output_tokens": reasoning_output_tokens,
 557:         },
 558:     )

 560: class CodexExecReasoningExecutor:
 561:     """Default reasoning adapter using Codex CLI with saved ChatGPT authentication.
 562: 
 563:     Reasoning stages run in a read-only sandbox. The SDD Orchestrator, not Codex,
 564:     writes validated artifacts into the repository. This keeps Stage authority and
 565:     write scope deterministic while avoiding a required OpenAI API key.
 566:     """
 567: 
 568:     def __init__(
 569:         self,
 570:         *,
 571:         executable: str = "codex",
 572:         model: str | None = None,
 573:         timeout_seconds: int = 1800,
 574:         ephemeral: bool = True,
 575:         ignore_user_config: bool = False,
 576:         repo_root: str | Path | None = None,
 577:         telemetry_recorder=None,
 578:     ):
 579:         self.executable = executable
 580:         self.model = model
 581:         self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
 582:         self.ephemeral = ephemeral
 583:         self.ignore_user_config = ignore_user_config
 584:         self.repo_root = Path(repo_root).resolve() if repo_root is not None else Path.cwd()
 585:         self.telemetry_recorder = telemetry_recorder
 586: 
 587:     def resolved_executable(self) -> str | None:
 588:         resolved = shutil.which(self.executable)
 589:         if resolved:
 590:             return resolved
 591:         if os.name == "nt" and not self.executable.lower().endswith((".cmd", ".exe", ".bat")):
 592:             return shutil.which(self.executable + ".cmd")
 593:         return None
 594: 
 595:     def available(self) -> bool:
 596:         return self.resolved_executable() is not None
 597: 
 598:     def command(self, schema_path: Path, output_path: Path, *, executable: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
 599:         cmd = [
 600:             executable or self.executable,
 601:             "exec",
 602:             "--sandbox",
 603:             "read-only",
 604:             "--output-schema",
 605:             str(schema_path),
 606:             "--output-last-message",
 607:             str(output_path),
 608:         ]
 609:         if self.ephemeral:
 610:             cmd.append("--ephemeral")
 611:         if self.ignore_user_config:
 612:             cmd.append("--ignore-user-config")
 613:         if self.model:
 614:             cmd.extend(["--model", self.model])
 615:         # Read the complete generated prompt from stdin. This avoids command-line
 616:         # length limits for large PRD/Spec/Design packets.
 617:         cmd.append("-")
 618:         return cmd
 619: 
 620:     def build_prompt(self, request: StageExecutionRequest) -> str:
 621:         return _provider_system_instructions(request) + "\n\n" + _provider_user_input(request)
 622: 
 623:     def execute(self, request: StageExecutionRequest) -> StageExecutionResult:
 624:         return self.dispatch(self.prepare(request))
 625: 
 626:     def prepare(self, request: StageExecutionRequest) -> PreparedCodexExecution:
 627:         executable = self.resolved_executable()
 628:         if not executable:
 629:             raise SharedReasoningProviderPrerequisiteError(
 630:                 "Codex CLI is not installed or not on PATH. Install Codex and run `codex login` with ChatGPT before using the default reasoning provider."
 631:             )
 632:         schema = _result_schema(request)
 633:         prompt = self.build_prompt(request)
 634:         return PreparedCodexExecution(
 635:             request=request,
 636:             executable=executable,
 637:             schema_json=json.dumps(schema, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
 638:             prompt=prompt,
 639:         )
 640: 
 641:     def dispatch(self, prepared: PreparedCodexExecution) -> StageExecutionResult:
 642:         request = prepared.request
 643:         prompt = prepared.prompt
 644:         with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=f"sdd-stage-{request.stage_id}-") as tmp:
 645:             tmpdir = Path(tmp)
 646:             schema_path = tmpdir / "result.schema.json"
 647:             output_path = tmpdir / "result.json"
 648:             schema_path.write_text(prepared.schema_json, encoding="utf-8")
 649: 
 650:             started = time.monotonic()
 651:             outcome = OutcomeCategory.FAILED
 652:             try:
 653:                 proc = subprocess.run(
 654:                     self.command(schema_path, output_path, executable=prepared.executable),
 655:                     input=prompt,
 656:                     text=True,
 657:                     encoding="utf-8",
 658:                     errors="strict",
 659:                     capture_output=True,
 660:                     cwd=self.repo_root,
 661:                     timeout=self.timeout_seconds,
 662:                 )
 663:                 if proc.returncode == 0:
 664:                     outcome = OutcomeCategory.COMPLETED
 665:             except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, TimeoutError):
 666:                 outcome = OutcomeCategory.TIMEOUT
 667:                 raise
 668:             finally:
 669:                 if self.telemetry_recorder is not None:
 670:                     try:
 671:                         duration_ms = max(0, round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
 672:                         event = measure_provider_call(
 673:                             stage_id=request.stage_id,
 674:                             rendered=[(prompt, Component.USER_INPUT)],
 675:                             wire=None,
 676:                             outcome_category=outcome,
 677:                             metadata={
 678:                                 "provider": "codex",
 679:                                 "model": self.model or "codex-config-default",
 680:                                 "adapter": "codex_exec_reasoning",
 681:                                 "interface": "subprocess_stdin",
 682:                                 "duration_ms": duration_ms,
 683:                             },
 684:                         )
 685:                         self.telemetry_recorder.record(event)
 686:                     except Exception:
 687:                         pass
 688:             if proc.returncode != 0:
 689:                 detail = (proc.stderr or proc.stdout or "").strip()
 690:                 if len(detail) > 6000:
 691:                     detail = detail[:2500] + "\n... [middle truncated] ...\n" + detail[-3500:]
 692:                 raise ReasoningProviderError(
 693:                     f"Codex reasoning execution failed ({proc.returncode}): {detail}"
 694:                 )
 695:             if not output_path.exists():
 696:                 raise ReasoningProviderError(
 697:                     "Codex did not write the expected --output-last-message file"
 698:                 )
 699:             raw = output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
 700:             try:
 701:                 data = json.loads(raw)
 702:             except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
 703:                 raise ReasoningProviderError(
 704:                     "Codex structured final response was not valid JSON"
 705:                 ) from exc
 706: 
 707:         artifact_list = data.get("artifacts", []) or []
 708:         artifacts = {
 709:             item["path"]: item["content"]
 710:             for item in artifact_list
 711:             if item.get("path") != "__NO_OUTPUT__"
 712:         }
 713:         return StageExecutionResult(
 714:             status=data["status"],
 715:             artifacts=artifacts,
 716:             result=data.get("result"),
 717:             classification=data.get("classification"),
 718:             remediation_reasons=list(data.get("remediation_reasons", [])),
 719:             convergence_tasks=list(data.get("convergence_tasks", [])),
 720:             metadata={
 721:                 "provider": "codex_exec_reasoning",
 722:                 "model": self.model or "codex-config-default",
 723:                 "sandbox": "read-only",
 724:                 "ephemeral": self.ephemeral,
 725:                 "provider_notes": data.get("provider_notes"),
 726:             },

 730: class OpenAIResponsesExecutor:
 731:     """Reasoning adapter using OpenAI's Responses API with Structured Outputs.
 732: 
 733:     This adapter intentionally uses the HTTP API directly so the core package
 734:     does not require an SDK dependency. The API key is read from the environment
 735:     and is never persisted into SDD run packets.
 736:     """
 737: 
 738:     endpoint = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
 739: 
 740:     def __init__(
 741:         self,
 742:         *,
 743:         model: str = "gpt-5.6",
 744:         api_key=[REDACTED] | None = None,
 745:         timeout_seconds: int = 300,
 746:         max_output_tokens: int = 12000,
 747:         telemetry_recorder=None,
 748:     ):
 749:         self.model = model
 750:         self.api_key=[REDACTED] or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
 751:         self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds
 752:         self.max_output_tokens = max_output_tokens
 753:         self.telemetry_recorder = telemetry_recorder
 754:         if not self.api_key=[REDACTED]             raise SharedReasoningProviderPrerequisiteError(
 756:                 "OPENAI_API_KEY is not set. Configure it in the environment; do not store it in repository files."
 757:             )
 758: 
 759:     def execute(self, request: StageExecutionRequest) -> StageExecutionResult:
 760:         return self.dispatch(self.prepare(request))
 761: 
 762:     def prepare(self, request: StageExecutionRequest) -> PreparedOpenAIExecution:
 763:         schema = _result_schema(request)
 764:         instructions = _provider_system_instructions(request)
 765:         user_input = _provider_user_input(request)
 766:         body = {
 767:             "model": self.model,
 768:             "instructions": instructions,
 769:             "input": user_input,
 770:             "max_output_tokens": self.max_output_tokens,
 771:             "text": {
 772:                 "format": {
 773:                     "type": "json_schema",
 774:                     "name": f"sdd_stage_{request.stage_id}_result",
 775:                     "strict": True,
 776:                     "schema": schema,
 777:                 }
 778:             },
 779:         }
 780:         wire = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
 781:         return PreparedOpenAIExecution(
 782:             request=request,
 783:             wire=wire,
 784:             instructions=instructions,
 785:             user_input=user_input,
 786:         )
 787: 
 788:     def dispatch(self, prepared: PreparedOpenAIExecution) -> StageExecutionResult:
 789:         request = prepared.request
 790:         wire = prepared.wire
 791:         req = urllib.request.Request(
 792:             self.endpoint,
 793:             data=wire,
 794:             headers={
 795:                 "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
 796:                 "Content-Type": "application/json",
 797:             },
 798:             method="POST",
 799:         )
 800:         started = time.monotonic()
 801:         outcome = OutcomeCategory.FAILED

 806:                     payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))

 814:                 raise ReasoningProviderError(
 815:                     f"OpenAI Responses API returned HTTP {exc.code}: {detail[:2000]}"
 816:                 ) from exc
 817:             except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
 818:                 if isinstance(exc.reason, TimeoutError):
 819:                     outcome = OutcomeCategory.TIMEOUT
 820:                 raise ReasoningProviderError(f"OpenAI Responses API request failed: {exc}") from exc
 821:             except (TimeoutError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
 822:                 outcome = OutcomeCategory.TIMEOUT
 823:                 raise

 825:             if self.telemetry_recorder is not None:
 826:                 try:
 827:                     duration_ms = max(0, round((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000))
